result.stdout:
USAGE:
    sigaba [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    init           Sets up the initial configuration                     
    encrypt        Encrypts all files defined in the configuration       
    decrypt        Decrypts all files defined in the configuration       
    edit <file>    Opens the specified file and encrypts it after editing

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Sets up the initial configuration

USAGE:
    sigaba init [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                                 DEFAULT                                        
    -h, --help                              Prints help information             
    -q, --quiet                             No console output. Same as verbosity
                                            level Quiet                         
        --verbosity              Normal     Sets the verbosity level            
    -n, --non-interactive                   Runs the command in non-interactive 
                                            mode                                
    -p, --password <PASSWORD>               Sets the password to decrypt the    
                                            private key                         
        --no-logo                           Disables the display of the logo
